OPEN_DOC.name: Kolaboro open data API
OPEN_DOC.note: Records use project ids; each project has its own page with its name and sourced facts at /projects/{slug}/, except projects in Sumba (conflict of interest). Scores describe what is public, not whether it is genuine.

endpoints.GET /api/open/stats: database totals (projects, markets, countries, claims tested, verification levels)
endpoints.GET /api/open/summary: small summary used by the site: totals, latest seal and shipping log
endpoints.GET /api/open/projects: projects; filters: market, country, stage (off-plan|under construction|completed), min_public (0-6), min_confirmed (0-6), all_six (1), flags (1|0), limit (max 1000), offset
endpoints.GET /api/open/projects/{id}/at/{YYYY-MM-: time travel: the project as published that day, from a daily snapshot checked against the public log
endpoints.GET /api/open/checkpoint: signed checkpoint of the public log (C2SP signed note): tree size and Merkle root of all daily heads
endpoints.GET /api/open/log-proof?day=YYYY-MM-DD: inclusion proof of one daily head in the checkpoint tree
endpoints.GET /api/open/log-consistency?first=M&se: RFC 9162 consistency proof: the tree of size N extends the tree of size M unchanged
endpoints.GET /api/open/evals: daily evaluation of the desk review on fixed fictional pages, case by case
endpoints.GET /api/open/uptime: uptime probes every 5 minutes from outside Cloudflare
endpoints.GET /api/open/build: which code commit is serving this API
endpoints.GET /api/open/pdf/{sha256}: is this case-file PDF exactly as Kolaboro created it? (registered SHA-256)
endpoints.GET /api/open/freshness: data freshness objective: share of projects re-read from their source in the last 7 days, per market
endpoints.GET /api/open/ai-spend: estimated daily spend of the website automated reading features and the daily cap that stops them
endpoints.GET /api/open/security: latest weekly security scan summary and decoy credentials touched
endpoints.GET /api/open/proof/{id}: Merkle inclusion proof that a project page fingerprint is in the daily root recorded in the public log (kolaboro.com/log)
endpoints.GET /api/open/changes?since=YYYY-MM-DD: every recorded change to a project field since a date, newest first
endpoints.GET /api/open/log: the public append-only log: one hash-chained head per day, each timestamped in Bitcoin
endpoints.GET /api/open/log-input: what goes into today's log head: dataset SHA-256 and the Merkle root of page fingerprints
endpoints.GET /api/open/receipt/{evidence_id}: signed receipt for one piece of site evidence: its SHA-256, position in the case hash chain and times
endpoints.Signatures: every answer is signed: x-kolaboro-signature = base64 Ed25519 over 'kolaboro-sig-v1\n' + SHA-256 hex of the body; key id in x-kolaboro-key-id; public keys at /.well-known/kolaboro-keys.json
endpoints.Headers: every answer carries x-kolaboro-dataset-sha256 (fingerprint of the dataset file it came from) and an ETag; send If-None-Match to get 304 when nothing changed
endpoints.GET /api/open/markets: per-market statistics and the transparency index (0-100)
endpoints.GET /feed.json, /feed.xml: shipping log and new data, JSON Feed and RSS
endpoints.GET /feed.xml?market=Bali: changes and alerts for one market or country
endpoints.GET /feed/alerts.xml: overdue, stalled and unapproved projects across all markets
endpoints.GET /api/open/badge/{id}.svg: live badge for a project, for portals and listings
